Markus, Lauren — attaching the latest roster (see attachment: subprocessor_roster_v3.pdf). Quick notes inline: 

- TrustVault (temporary escrow) — used only for encrypted snapshot storage during major migrations; access requires dual approval from Ops and Security, keys are customer-scoped and stored in our KMS-backed HSM. No application-layer plaintext processing occurs in the escrow environment.
- Processing role: snapshot store / limited restore capability (used during DR or cutover testing). Country: US primary, with temporary EU staging during controlled cutovers (explicitly disabled by default).
- Controls: quarterly attestation from TrustVault, monthly access logs forwarded to our SIEM, time-limited access windows, and encrypted at-rest with AEAD and KMS-managed keys.

On the DPA question: adding TrustVault as a temporary or emergency partner is a substantive change to the roster and our security team typically asks for a DPA addendum (short form) that references the existing DPA and adds the escrow partner with a limited-purpose annex (scope, access controls, retention window). A full DPA re-execution is usually unnecessary for temporary/escrow-only partners.

I've started a redline with recommended language (dpa_redline_proposal_2024-07.docx). High-level suggestion: 1) add TrustVault in the subprocessor roster table with role=\"escrow snapshot storage\"; 2) reference attestation cadence and access window; 3) limit data type to encrypted snapshots (no plaintext, no customer-provided raw logs).

Sending Aditya to confirm whether the EU staging temporarily introduces cross-border transfers requiring SCCs or equivalent.

- Kimberly
Director, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Kimberly — quick confirmation on transfers: if we ever stage snapshots in EU for a cutover, that is technically a cross-border transfer. For FinPulse (EU data subjects), we'd rely on SCCs or an approved transfer mechanism. In practice, we set staging to 'disabled' unless customer explicitly permits and we document the temporary window in the addendum. Action items:

- Procurement: add a clause that any EU staging requires written consent and a documented transfer window.
- Security: include a statement that escrow snapshots are stored encrypted and keys are not exported to third parties.
- Legal: route the short addendum to customer legal with the proposed DocuSign link.

I'll attach the recent TrustVault attestation summary to the Drive folder (link above).
